The decisive mistake was made by Tizin_Translation_Expert at step 1. The verb "Maktay" means "is pleasing to", so the thing being liked (apples) is the subject and the person doing the liking is the object. The expert instead treated "apples" as the direct object and "I" as the subject. That led to "Zapple" (accusative) and "Pa" (nominative).

The correct translation uses "Mato" (accusative "me") as the direct object and "Apple" (nominative) as the subject, giving "Maktay mato apple". Verification_Expert later confirmed the wrong answer, but the error began at step 1.
